attributes.title: Playhead
attributes.lede: A hand that clicks for you. Drag the playhead and watch it think.

lesson.concept: One state reducer serves clicks and seeking
lesson.why: Buttons and the transport use the same semantic actions. Seeking folds the actions before the requested time into application state, so the view and the score cannot silently describe different apps.
lesson.experiment: Open a control, scrub before its action, then forward again. Compare the reconstructed selection and switch state with an ordinary click.
lesson.pitfall: Replaying old pointer events at wall-clock speed makes backward seeking depend on history.
lesson.combine: Combine with build-order when a reproducible app interaction needs named visual beats.
